subject: Mythology
title: Sita: The Ideal of Virtue
description: One-minute skill: Sita: The Ideal of Virtue.

hook.text: Sita was kidnapped by the demon king Ravana, sparking a war that would decide the fate of the world.

buildup.text: She refused to submit to Ravana despite captivity, waiting faithfully for Rama to rescue her.

discovery.text: After rescue, Rama questioned her purity. She walked through fire to prove her innocence and emerged unburned.

twist.text: Despite passing the fire test, public gossip led Rama to banish her. She raised their sons alone in a forest.

climax.text: Modern readers debate whether Sita represents ideal virtue or a story of unjust treatment by a flawed hero.

punchline.text: Her story is still debated because its questions about justice never got old.

quiz.question: How did Sita prove her innocence after being rescued?
options: She swore an oath before the assembled gods
She walked through fire and emerged unburned
